answer: The ledger sets each entry stake at 20 credits × (1 + J/10)², where J counts keys admitted in the last 8 epochs, and holds it in glacier escrow for 30 epochs. Same-block signups are priced in sequence, so the 50th fake costs about 700 credits, and locked funds cannot back another key. New keys may bid only on sparrow jobs capped at 5 credits, so no fake earns its stake back early. A key leaving escrow hollow, with no accepted job, forfeits half.
